entities.summary: Robert La Caze was a Moroccan and French racing driver, who competed under the Moroccan flag in Formula One at the Moroccan Grand Prix in 1958. La Caze remains the only Moroccan driver to compete in Formula One. In rallying, La Caze was a two-time winner of the Rallye du Maroc in 1954 and 1967.
